title: The Best Hilton Hotels for a Music-Filled Nashville Staycation
summary: From live music and rooftop cocktails to art-filled spaces and rooms designed for groups, these downtown Hilton hotels make it easy to experience Music City without leaving town.
contentText:

If you’re a live music lover, and staycation enthusiast, then there’s no place to explore the robust live music scene and rich music history than Nashville, Tennessee. The city offers a wonderful blend of Southern charm and hospitality with a modern urban lifestyle with countless live music venues and concert halls. It’s no wonder why Nashville has the perfect nickname of “Music City.”

In addition, the city offers a wide selection of world-class museums, notable restaurants and all sorts of fun bars and cocktail lounges from low-key dive bars to upscale and swanky cocktail lounges. It’s really the place to be for music lovers.

Hilton’s downtown Nashville portfolio offers several distinct ways to experience Music City, whether you want an art-forward boutique stay, flexible accommodations for a group or a rooftop setting with live local music. Here are four Hilton hotels to consider for your next Nashville staycation.

The Untitled Nashville Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton

Book Now Online

Located at 221 2nd Avenue North, The Untitled Nashville Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton (formerly known as Bankers Alley Hotel) is central to beloved honky-tonks and live music on Broadway — adjacent to Bankers Alley. In fact, the hotel is just mere steps away from the action in the city and less than a mile away from Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena and Ryman Auditorium.

But what makes The Untitled Nashville Hotel unique is its art-filled corridors and lobbies with thoughtfully crafted dining at Gray & Dudley, which features seasonal ingredients and handcrafted cocktails. It features a well-equipped fitness center, multiple art galleries that highlight regional artists and a terrace.

Motto by Hilton Nashville Downtown

Motto by Hilton Nashville Downtown at 311 3rd Avenue South is located near iconic attractions, including Country Music Hall of Fame, Ascend Amphitheater, Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena, Ryman Auditorium, The Grand Ole Opry and other must-see music stops. Its signature restaurant is Junie’s, which serves elevated Southern dishes, craft cocktails and offers live music nightly. There’s even a cute café that serves morning specialty coffee and treats. The property is ideal for large groups with accommodations for groups up to 15 people in connected rooms, while it’s also walkable to the downtown base.

The Printing House Hotel Nashville Downtown, Tapestry by Hilton

Opened in September 2025, The Printing House Hotel Nashville Downtown, Tapestry by Hilton at 501 3rd Avenue South offers mid-century influences, historical details and Nashville’s printing heritage for an overall unique experience for music lovers and travelers, alike. It’s located near the legendary Honky Tonk Highway (Lower Broadway), Printer’s Alley and Ryman Auditorium, and works as a great starting point when visiting and discovering Music City. The property features The Letterpress Lounge & Terrace, which offers guests live music, quick bites and crafted signature cocktails on its rooftop that offers indoor-outdoor seating and skyline views. It’s definitely a great place for a design-forward staycation with rooftop views and live local music and to connect with Nashville’s art and music scene.

If you’re planning a staycation, booking directly through Hilton can unlock additional value. Hilton Honors members can earn Points on eligible stays and receive benefits such as member rates, free standard Wi-Fi, and access to the Hilton Honors app. Participating Nashville properties also allow members to earn and redeem Points during their stay.
